title: Eton Academy
subtitle: savannah, georgia April 22-24, 2026
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Eton Academy. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Arrival & Exploration of Savannah

  • Travel to Savannah, GA
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Savannah’s Historic District
  • Group exploration of River Street Market Place
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Guided Ghost Tour
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (two nights)
 

Day 2: Tybee Island & Sunset Dolphin Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Slave Quarters Museum 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit Tybee Island Light Station & Museum
  • Tybee Island’s Black History Trail 
  • Sunset Dolphin Tour
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Wormsloe Historic Site & Oatland Wildlife Center

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Wormsloe Historic Site
  • Visit Oatland Island Wildlife Center
  • Boxed sandwich lunch
  • Depart for Home
